Job Posting: 179024 - Position: S26 IT Security & Risk Management - Summer Student 179024B Co-op Work Term Posted: 2026 - Summer App Deadline Application Method: Posting Goes Live: Job Posting Status: 03/13/2026 03:00 PM Through Employer Website 03/10/2026 03:31 PM Approved ORGANIZATION INFORMATION Organization City Province / State Country Alberta Pensions Services Corporation (APS) Edmonton AB Canada JOB POSTING INFORMATION Placement Term <b> Job Title <b> Position Type Job Location Country Duration Salary Currency Salary Job Description 2026 - Summer S26 IT Security & Risk Management - Summer Student 179024B Co-op Position Edmonton, AB Canada 4 months CAD 27.4 per hour for 0 Major List IT Security & Risk Management - Summer Student Req #378 Position: Summer Student IT Security & Risk Management Position Type: Casual Location: Edmonton, Alberta Classification: Pay Group I Salary Range: $27.40 plus Vacation & Holiday Pay Duration: May 4, 2026 ending August 28, 2026 Closing Date: March 13, 2026 @ 4:00 p.m. MST Description The summer student will be involved with the IT Security & Risk Management (ITSRM) team by contributing to a range of cybersecurity-focused operational and project activities. This role provides hands-on exposure to real-world security operations while allowing the student to apply concepts from their academic program. Working closely with ITSRM team members, the student will assist with threat, vulnerability and cybersecurity incident management, security assessments, research, documentation, and automation, as well as participate in project-based initiatives aligned with their skills and interests. Key Responsibilities Security Assessment & Research Support • Assist in internal and external security assessments. • Review system architecture, data flow diagrams, and related documentation to support security and risk assessments. Prepare briefing notes, summaries, or short presentations for the team. • Threat, Vulnerability, and Cybersecurity Incident Management Support • Review alerts from network and security services and assist with rule optimization. • Track and support risk assessments of and response to emerging vulnerabilities, industry incidents, and evolving security standards (e.g., CISA, vendor, and NIST updates). • Update or create network, data flow, and security architecture diagrams; documentation using tools such as Visio. Support documentation or testing of baseline configuration workflows. • Daily Operational Security Tasks • Review vulnerability and patch management reports; identify critical items and document remediation recommendations. • Track remediation progress and follow up with system or application owners. • Participate in initial incident investigations, including log collection, ticket documentation, and drafting incident summaries. Contribute to post incident review and lessons learned documentation following security events. • Project-Based Contributions (Assigned based on skillset, interest, and project schedules and tasks) • Test mobile device management (MDM) enrollment workflows, conditional access policies, and device compliance configurations. • Validate security baselines and security services' protection settings and perform testing as needed. • Support scripting or automation tasks such as log parsing, report formatting, or dashboard creation. • Assist with cloud environment solution and process documentation. Participate in access control reviews for SaaS applications. • Learning & Professional Development • Shadow cybersecurity specialists • Shadow other ITSRM team members for exposure to Business Resilience (BCP/DRP), Identity and Access Management (IAM), Information Management and AI Governance, IT Change and Release Management, IT Governance/Risk/Compliance (GRC) + Audit, and Security Awareness and Education. • Attend security partner and vendor demos and meetings, internal project discussions, and team knowledge-sharing sessions. • Engage in hands-on learning to deepen understanding of the organization's security environment. Why choose APS APS is made up of hard-working, respectful and talented people who understand and invite diversity to the workplace. We take pride in holding ourselves accountable and continuing to meet or exceed service levels for plan members, pensioners and employers. We ensure they receive quality services because they-along with our people-are the reason we endure and succeed. And it sure feels good helping hard-working Albertans receive their well-deserved pensions. Job Requirements Required Education Student enrolled in a Bachelor of Science - Computer Science (Systems & Information Security) or equivalent program with a systems and information security/cybersecurity stream. Knowledge, Skills & Attributes Required • Foundational knowledge of cybersecurity concepts, networking, operating systems (e.g., Windows), and threat, vulnerability, and cybersecurity incident management. • Strong analytical and research skills, with the ability to interpret technical information. • Ability to learn quickly, ask thoughtful questions, and apply academic knowledge to practical scenarios. • Clear communication skills, professionalism, and the ability to collaborate effectively. • Basic understanding of architecture and data flow concepts. • Experience with technical documentation. Nice-to-Have • Knowledge of industry frameworks (e.g., ISO 27001/27002 Standard, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, CIS Controls). • Prior participation in cybersecurity events (e.g., relevant webinars/online conferences, BSides conference). • Experience with: • Cloud security (e.g., Azure, SaaS services) • Enterprise security tools (e.g., anti-malware/endpoint protection) • Project planning and business requirements • Security research Scripting or automation • What We're Really Looking For A motivated and curious student who: • Brings professionalism and a willingness to learn. • Is comfortable researching independently using documentation, online resources, and AI tools. • Shows initiative and isn't intimidated by unfamiliar technologies or concepts. • Enjoys problem-solving and analytical work. Works well in a team and contributes positively to the security culture. • Citizenship Requirement N/A APPLICATION INFORMATION Application Procedure Through Employer Website Special Application Instructions Application Link: IT Security & Risk Management - Summer Student | Dayforce Jobs Please click the "I intend to apply to this position" button on SCOPE and also submit your application via the employer's website.
